scientific.integrity_notes: The proof is a character-theoretic argument; no finite computation is used as proof. The closest source gives mixed-prime examples and p-group constituent-count input but not this full rank-correction formula. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The formula is for a nontrivial finite p-group P and a finite abelian q-group A with p != q, over the complex numbers. It does not treat nonabelian second factors, same-prime products, or positive-characteristic representations.

title: Exact mixed-prime formula for a finite abelian factor
